explanation.headline: Oxycodone and acetaminophen is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale Lakeside holds 13.9 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows oxycodone and acetaminophen is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Corvale East holds 526 tablets at 16.6 per day for 31.6 days on hand; Corvale General holds 493 tablets at 18.9 per day for 26.1 days on hand; Corvale Lakeside holds 76 tablets at 5.5 per day for 13.9 days on hand.
Corvale General also holds 512 units of the 5 mg/5 mL solution at 19.5 per day for 26.2 days on hand.
The label for Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) shows a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-07-16.
That plant received an OAI classification in 2009 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, followed by multiple VAI inspections through 2026.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Alvogen, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.
Alternate manufacturers Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC and Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC are also not on the shortage list and have no placeable plant on their labels.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
